read_delta_from_path: read a Delta lake table from a local filesystem path into a Polars DataFrame
scan_delta_lazily: scan a Delta lake table lazily and return a Polars LazyFrame for deferred execution
read_delta_version: read a specific version of a Delta lake table by numerical version number
read_delta_time_travel: time travel a Delta lake table using a timestamp version
scan_delta_cloud_storage: scan a Delta lake table from AWS S3, GCS, or Azure with storage options
